headline: 9 measures in nine jurisdictions: permission needed to build AI
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Nine measures in nine jurisdictions would require government permission before an AI system may be built or deployed.

125 measures in 28 jurisdictions would create an AI office, or hand an existing one new authority over AI.

195 named offices would gain a power over AI. The one named most often is the New Jersey Board of Public Utilities, in eight measures.

1,435 measures tracked. 508 carry a control. 195 offices hold one.
